question: What fraction of officially inactive players appear on the NFL injury report at all?
have: Measured on the 8 clubs where every live row was read and joined to the official inactive list: 26 of 46 inactive players (56.5%) do not appear on the injury report in any form. Excluding the two emergency third quarterbacks, 24 of 44 (54.5%).
missing: The other 16 clubs of Week 10, and every prior week.
clears: The same join computed for all 32 clubs and at least one full season, with the denominator published and the emergency-third-QB rows separated out.

Three official records (injury report, inactive lists, reserve list) explain 16 of 17 (94.1%); Kerby Joseph (DET) remains unexplained.
